_about: Shared agent skills this project uses (Agent/Skills catalog ids; dependsOn are added automatically). The skill files are not committed: install them once per clone with powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-skills\repo\agent-skills.ps1" init -Project . (first time on this machine: git clone https://APZABS5ASC.corpnet.asus:8010/Agent/Skills "$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-skills\repo"). Change the list with agent-skills.ps1 add / remove, or edit "skills" and commit.
